processing: Select Spain, France, Andorra; clip WGS84 frame; exact spherical Web Mercator; clip exact projected bbox; subtract unchanged ICGC Catalunya for context fill; no simplification, 0.001 pixel SVG rounding. Coastline is the country polygon shoreline. Boundary strokes exclude artificial crop edges.
limitations: Natural Earth 1:10 million coastline is generalized independently of ICGC 1:500000. ICGC remains authoritative for Catalunya. The bbox includes a northern sliver of Menorca from Spain.

derivedContextStrokes.method: Subtract a 2.30 canonical-pixel buffer of unchanged ICGC exterior from Natural Earth context strokes only; reconnect cut endpoints to nearest ICGC exterior within the same band. Keep every original context segment outside the band. No fill, terrain, comarca, bbox or projection changes.
derivedContextStrokes.ownership: ICGC owns Catalunya exterior including shoreline; Natural Earth retains surrounding country borders and coast beyond local junction reconciliation.
derivedContextStrokes.limitations: Presentation tolerance, not geographic accuracy. Short straight junction connectors reconcile independent generalization; original Natural Earth geometry and source provenance are saved. Offline SVG renders are not native alignment validation.
